name: Pet-image edge-transition steepness — unverified guidance
name_basis: explicit guidance target plus measured validation association; no index-based rotation of semantic names
score_definition: Sigmoid of a pooled response standardized using training-only running statistics; 0.5 denotes the estimated training mean. This is not class-probability calibration.
weight_interpretation: Relative classifier use; class weights do not name the visual concept.
domain_scope: Pet breed classification. Texture/region associations alone do not establish fur type, muzzle anatomy or disease. Foreground trimap alignment is localization evidence, not proof of a breed-specific semantic concept.
human_review: Inspect multiple training prototype patches and held-out overlays. Confirm consistency, foreground support, and lack of background shortcuts; do not infer medical or part semantics from correlation.
